sentences.text:
Dated this the 5th day of June, 2025 Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.1601 of 2019 registered at the Mannar Police Station for the offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC, now pending as C.C.
No.6162 of 2019 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Chengannur.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Chengannur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. The crime is registered on the allegation that, by promising to secure admission to B.Sc.Forensic Science for CW2 at Aditya Educational Institute in Andhra Pradesh, accused collected Rs.25,000/-
by way of DD from the defacto complainant, but did not secure the admission or refund the amount.

3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submitted that the dispute, which led to the incident and 2025:KER:39820 registration of the crime, is amicably settled between the parties and an affidavit to that effect has been filed by the 3rd respondent, vouching this fact.
4.
Learned Counsel for the 3rd respondent also submitted that the dispute is settled and his client has no grievance against the petitioner.

Having considered the gravity of the offence alleged and having perused the affidavit, contents of which is vouched to be true and voluntary by the Counsel for the 3rd respondent, I am satisfied that no public interest is involved in this matter and the dispute has been settled amicably.
In view of the settlement, there is no possibility of the criminal proceedings ending in conviction.

As such,
continuance of the proceedings will amount to an abuse of process 2025:KER:39820 of court and hence, in view of the legal position set out by the Honourable Supreme Court in Madan Mohan Abbot v State of Punjab [(2008) 4 SCC 582] and Gian Singh v State of Punjab and Another [(2012)
10 SCC 303], there is no impediment in granting the relief.

sentences.text: In the result, this Crl.M.C is allowed.

Annexure B final report and all further proceedings in Crime No.1601 of 2019 registered at the Mannar Police Station, now pending as C.C. No.6162 of 2019 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Chengannur, as against the petitioner, is quashed.
